name: Nagydorog (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of pale blue and tan triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagydorog: a blue and green shield with a sun, a crescent, an iris and a church, within a tan frame.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of pale blue and tan triangles
